The crib is more than just a piece of furniture; it's the heart of the nursery, where your baby will dream, grow, and wake up to new adventures each day. If you imagine your baby’s first sleeping space, chances are, a wooden crib comes to mind. Timeless, sturdy, and designed to withstand the early years of parenthood, wooden cribs have remained a beloved choice for generations. Whether your style leans modern and minimalist or classic and cozy, there’s a wooden crib that’s perfect for your baby’s first sleep sanctuary.

Why Wood? Safety, Strength, and Style

When it comes to baby furniture, safety and durability come first. That’s where wooden cribs truly shine. Typically crafted from strong hardwoods like oak, maple, birch, or beech, these cribs are built to last. Whether you prefer a natural wood finish, a soft stain, or a crisp white crib, there’s a style that seamlessly fits your nursery.

But it’s not just about aesthetics—it’s about peace of mind. Babies explore the world with their mouths, and teething babies will chew on everything, including their crib. That’s why choosing the right material matters. Kiln-dried beech wood cribs—like the Soho 3-in-1 Convertible Crib—are naturally tough, resistant to biting, and designed to stand the test of time.

Unlike softer woods like pine, which can show chew marks and wear over time, beech wood retains its smooth, durable surface. Choosing a beech wood crib means fewer dents, fewer scratches, and a crib that looks just as beautiful for baby number two (or three!).


You can see how pine cribs struggle under little teeth—soft wood splintering, paint chipping, and even pieces coming loose, creating safety concerns.


A beechwood crib remains pristine despite everyday use. Its naturally denser composition makes it much harder for teething toddlers to leave marks, ensuring a long-lasting, safe, and beautiful crib—without the need for additional rail guards or constant worry.

And if sustainability is on your mind, wooden cribs are a responsible choice. Many brands, including dadada, prioritize eco-friendly practices by sourcing wood sustainably. Coupled with today’s rigorous safety standards, wooden cribs continue to be the gold standard for safe and stylish nursery design.

What to Look for When Choosing a Wooden Crib

Shopping for a crib can be overwhelming, but keeping a few key factors in mind makes all the difference:

Safety First

Look for certifications like GREENGUARD Gold, which guarantees that the crib meets stringent standards for chemical emissions and indoor air quality. All of dadada’s cribs are GREENGUARD Gold Certified and meet the highest quality standards.

Conversion Potential

Many modern cribs, like the Spirit 8-in-1 Convertible Crib, transition from crib to toddler bed to daybed and even a floor bed, ensuring 5 years of continuous use and beyond for other children.

Material Matters

Hardwoods like beech, maple, and oak offer superior strength and longevity compared to softer woods like pine.

Design Aesthetic

Whether you prefer a modern, Scandinavian-inspired crib or a warm, traditional wood tone, the right crib should complement your nursery and your family’s lifestyle.

Top Wooden Cribs to Consider

Spirit 8-in-1 Convertible Crib

A true nursery investment, the Spirit 8-in-1 Convertible Crib transitions from a cradle to a crib, toddler bed, and multiple daybed and floor bed configurations. Crafted from kiln-dried, sustainably sourced beech wood, this GREENGUARD Gold Certified crib includes all necessary conversion kits, ensuring you won’t need to worry about additional purchases down the road.

Soho 3-in-1 Convertible Crib

For parents who love modern design, the Soho 3-in-1 Convertible Crib delivers clean lines and a mid-century modern aesthetic. Made from kiln-dried, sustainably sourced beech wood, this GREENGUARD Gold Certified crib features three crib heights and a design that blends seamlessly with any nursery. (Conversion kit sold separately here.)

Bliss 4-in-1 Convertible Crib

A smart investment for growing families. Crafted from kiln-dried, sustainably sourced beechwood, its mid-century modern design features clean lines, rounded edges, and tapered legs. GREENGUARD Gold Certified, it adjusts in height and converts into a toddler bed, daybed, and floor bed, adapting as your child grows for the next 5 years. (Conversion kit sold separately here.)

The Right Accessories to Elevate Your Nursery

A crib is the centerpiece of the nursery, but thoughtful additions can enhance both function and style.

Matching Crib & Dresser Sets

For a cohesive, polished look, many parents opt for a matching crib and dresser set. With engineered wood construction, soft-close drawers, and optional changing table trays, dadada dressers like the Soho Dresser are built to last and provide much-needed storage for baby essentials.



Mobiles & Add-Ons

A mobile adds a touch of whimsy and visual interest to your baby’s sleep space. Opt for a wooden mobile arm to complement your crib’s natural beauty. Just remember—once your little one can push up on their hands and knees (around five months), safety guidelines recommend removing the mobile.

Crib Safety & Quality: What Parents Should Know

When it comes to your baby’s crib, safety is everything. The best wooden cribs meet or exceed rigorous industry standards, ensuring a secure and healthy sleep environment.

Non-Toxic Finishes & Certifications

Babies explore with their hands and mouths, which is why choosing a crib with non-toxic, baby safe finishes is essential. All dadada cribs are GREENGUARD Gold Certified, meaning they’ve been tested for over 10,000 chemicals and VOCs to guarantee cleaner indoor air.

Why Wooden Cribs Are the Best Choice

  • Unmatched Safety – dadada cribs meet and exceed safety standards, from slat spacing to non-toxic finishes.
  • Adapts as Your Child Grows – Convertible cribs transition seamlessly from infancy to preschool years, offering years of use.
  • Built to Last – Solid beechwood resists dents, scratches, and wear, making it a solid investment for growing families.
  • Eco-Friendly Appeal – Sustainably sourced materials make wooden cribs a smart choice for environmentally conscious parents.

Wooden cribs are the foundation of a well-designed nursery, and with dadada’s superior craftsmanship, you’re choosing safety, durability, and timeless beauty. No matter your style preference—natural or white wood—dadada cribs offer the highest quality in comfort and aesthetics, making them a trusted choice for parents everywhere.
